shared_links.basis: AcceptanceCriterion fixture validates typed authored and derived properties through Entity payload and physical projection.
Agent and Skill native records prove cross-kind identity separation and direct declared membership.
Decision fixture with proposed approval fails snapshot validation.
Document fixture retains declared component filtering and reports unresolved membership.
Both SourceFile and Test fixtures reach native property mapping without refreshing pinned source evidence.

shared_database_evidence.scope: Shared property publication mechanism tested with an AcceptanceCriterion fixture; not 17 separate live reader tests.
